title: G31: specify and prove settable 1000p per-company AI caps
public_pr_body:
Rhys's 5 November decision supersedes #381's earlier required-500p finding for release 146's Tolra-provided mode: default GBP 10 (1000p) per company per calendar month, independently settable, AI OFF by default. Old evidence is retained as historical; no application or migration implementation changes.

Six committed-code tests pass, zero skipped: new-company defaults/off, exact setter operation, privilege/non-owner refusal, concurrent separate company budgets, raising a cap and refusing an unsafe reduction, and cap refusal stopping before key/provider access. Full public numbered chain plus 145/146/147 at 9d7725e runs in a newly created nonce-identified network-isolated PostgreSQL container with synthetic records. Minimal Auth/Storage prerequisites are explicit; no running services or real provider call. Code c4a3fa4; original logs/SQL hashes/identity/commit/environment/time/exits retained. Lint and TypeScript passed.

Actual setter is ai_helper_tolra_set_cap(uuid,integer,uuid), a platform-owner administrator operation through the service-role server path. Company admin/office/anon direct calls refuse. Final server route/MFA proof remains separate. Legacy own-key 122 still has its distinct 500p default; this PR neither changes it nor claims alignment of all modes. Spec: docs/audit/G31-AI-CAP-SPEC.md.

G31: 6 passed, 0 skipped; provided-mode decision verified in synthetic SQL. Separate branch from main; docs/tests only. No merge, production SQL/configuration, private files, #359/go-live edits, live AI or message to John.
